mechanism: Dronedarone inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, increasing aripiprazole plasma concentrations and risk of adverse effects including QT prolongation; both drugs have cardiac electrophysiologic effects.
action: Monitor closely for aripiprazole toxicity (akathisia, extrapyramidal symptoms, orthostasis); consider aripiprazole dose reduction; monitor ECG for QT prolongation.
